name: io.github.Shweta-Mishra-ai/tokenmizer
description: Graph-backed session memory for LLMs: checkpoint, resume, file analysis, token-savings stats.

packageArguments.description: Runs the MCP stdio server. The pypi console script matching this package's own name (tokenmizer) is the CLI, not the MCP server — 'mcp' selects the MCP subcommand so an installer that runs `tokenmizer <packageArguments>` reaches it (the server.json schema has no separate field for a differently named entry point).

environmentVariables.name: TOKENMIZER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the running TokenMizer proxy (default http://localhost:8000)

environmentVariables.name: TOKENMIZER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key if the proxy has auth enabled
